LanguageData.Gun_M82Gun.description:
巴雷特M82并不是狙击步枪——它实际上是半自动反器材步枪。它使用.50BMG，一种用于机枪的弹药。这种弹药的精度比通常的7.62狙击弹要差。
类型：.50 BMG 反器材步枪
优点：高伤害/高射速
缺点：低精度
LanguageData.RF_Gun_HecateII.label: PGM黑卡蒂II
LanguageData.RF_Gun_HecateII.description:
The Hecate II is the bigger sister of the PGM Ultima Ratio rifle. It's slightly more accurate than the Marret M82, but is not semi-automatic. 
Type: .50 BMG Anti-Materiel Rifle
Pros: High damage / Fair accuraccy
Cons: Bolt-action
LanguageData.Gun_ATR.label: Monomakh AMR
LanguageData.Gun_ATR.description:
The Monomakh is an advanced anti-materiel rifle. The 14.5x114mm rounds deliver much more energy than the .50 BMG, and at greater range and accuracy. It's a semi-automatic gun with a 5-round magazine.
Type: 14.5mm Anti-Materiel Rifle
Pros: Very high damage / Good accuracy
Cons: Weight / Size / Production costs
LanguageData.Gun_TAMSR.description:
The 14.5mm SRS99 was an anti-materiel rifle used by the UN Space Command. It's ultra-light spacer-tech polymer construction allows for a slightly more manageable mass, and electromagnetic drivers assists bullet propellant and stabilization producing exceptional range with a relatively short barrel. It's still a beast to carry compared to other rifles.
Type: 14.5mm Anti-Materiel Rifle
Pros: Very high damage / Long range
Cons: Advanced production costs

LanguageData.Gun_M60GPMG.description:
A general purpose belt-fed machine gun. The starter belt only contains 50 rounds, but an ammo box attachement can increase it to 150. Foldable bipod included. Received the nickname "The Pig" due to its bulky size and appetite for ammunition.
Type: 7.62x51mm LMG / MMG

LanguageData.Gun_HeavyCombatRifle.description:

Pros: Powerful / Fast cooldown / Fast reload

LanguageData.RF_Gun_XMeight.description:
The Mark 2 Lancer is an effective assault rifle, but what really sets it apart from others is its chainsaw bayonet, which is good for cutting through enemies, trees, walls, and the intimidating sound of gunfire. 5.56x45mm
Type: 5.56mm Assault Rifle
Pros: Chainsaw bayonet
Cons: Poor range
LanguageData.Gun_MarineSturmRifle.description:
The Morita II is the standard weapon provided for the UCF Mobile Infantry. If it looks like a cheap plastic gun, that's because it is. It just going into the meat grinder anyway. Nevertheless, this long-barrelled bullpup AR shoots straight and shoots a lot, so when a scope is added and with great skill, it becomes an effective Designated Marksman Rifle.
Type: 5.56mm Assault / Marksman Rifle 
Pros: Good Range / Fast production
Cons: No iron sights / Difficult to aim

LanguageData.Gun_HeavySMG.description:
The Spectre M4 is designed for close quarters combat and is easy to maneuver. It's got an impressive range too, but without advanced skills, it is only effective at close range.
Type: .45 Submachinegun
Pros: Quick / Decent range
Cons: High recoil / Steep learning curve
LanguageData.Gun_BoltActionRifle.label: 恩菲尔德步枪
LanguageData.Gun_BoltActionRifle.description:
An ancient bolt-action rifle. The M1917 Enfield is a .30-06 modification of the .303 Lee Enfield. It's a simple design, slow firing, and moderately powerful. Good for hunting and can be modified into a makeshift sniper rifle.
 Type: .30-06 Rifle
Pros: Low production costs
Cons: Low fire rate / low range for a sniper
LanguageData.RF_Gun_ARFifty.label: M1 加兰德
LanguageData.RF_Gun_ARFifty.description:
A gun that won a war, the M1 is a semi-automatic rifle. It's simple, accurate, reliable and effective.
Type: .30-06 Rifle
Pros: Simple production / Semi-automatic
Cons: No magazine options / low range for a sniper
LanguageData.RF_Gun_WA2K.description:
A replica of a peculiar sniper rifle which saw limited production centuries ago. It's easy to maneuver thanks to the bullpup construction (the breach is behind the grip), and because it is semi-automatic, it can almost be used like a battle rifle.
Type: 7.62x51mm Sniper Rifle
Pros: Compact / Semi-automatic
Cons: Mediocre sights and range
LanguageData.Gun_SniperRifle.label: M24狙击步枪
LanguageData.Gun_SniperRifle.description:
A high-performance bolt-action sniper rifle based the Remington 700 hunting rifle.
Type: 7.62x51mm Sniper Rifle
Pros: Range / Accuracy
Cons: Bolt-action
LanguageData.Gun_M42A_USCM.label: VC52 Battle Sniper
LanguageData.Gun_M42A_USCM.description:
When the War Crimes Concord was dissolved, nations began using anti-materiel calibers for antiperonnel weapons. The VC53, a 50-cal semi-auto modification of the Helghast VC32 rifle, was on such attempt. It's useful as a sniper rifle and to an extent, a battle rifle. Uses an integrated helical magazine.
Type: .50 BMG Sniper / Battle Rifle
Pros: Range / Power / Quick
Cons: Advanced Production / No magazine options
